status: Analysis fixed before new probe outcomes; original benchmarks already inspected during development
procedure: StandardScaler fit on fitting features; LogisticRegression C=1, max_iter=5000; all features rounded to ten decimals; identical procedure at initialization and after training
observables: Original model readout features: Angle local-Z plus neighboring ZZ; Amplitude and QSM local-Z
initialization: Reconstruct original torch seed and constructor; compare with saved initial states where available
evaluations: All declared datasets, seeds, candidates and stages; no test selection, tuning or quantum retraining
primary: Within model/dataset/seed paired test BA(trained features) - BA(initial features)
controls: Fixed C=1 logistic on exactly the candidate input coordinates; deterministic initial/trained models must reproduce saved validation and test predictions
interpretation: Descriptive retrospective probe analysis; readouts, information access and fitting budgets differ between model families; not a causal encoding ranking or independent replication
